quarterly_data.quarter: Gates Industrial press release: Gates Completes Acquisition of the Belts Business from The (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Gates completed the acquisition of the belts business of The Timken Company, including select manufacturing assets (announced September 28, 2026). The company says the acquisition expands Gates' North American power transmission with additional manufacturing capacity and customer relationships across industrial original equipment manufacturers (OEM), the industrial aftermarket and mobility power sports markets; as part of the transaction Gates is also assuming operational control of the belts manufacturing facility in San Jose Iturbide, Mexico. Tom Pitstick, president, Americas at Gates: the completion 'strengthens Gates' position in power transmission and supports our strategy to grow in industrial and mobility markets.' Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: seller of the acquired belts business
